notes: Run twice each: as-is 78 passed / 35 failed (stable); with the scratch bool-coercing waitUntil plugin 111 passed / 2 failed (the 2 selftest needs_merge), stable over 2 runs. tests/ untouched.

33 harness-bug failures: 19 in test_controller.py, 13 in test_controls_panel.py (the _panel() helper's waitUntil returns a list), 1 in test_grid_tiles.py::test_double_click_toggles_fullscreen_quality.

Controller: private daemon WorkerPool (idle expiry, joinable) + per-camera serial strands: 'control' (connect/stream/PTZ/status/presets/recordings) and 'io' (downloads, so a long download never blocks PTZ). GUI marshalling through a private queued pyqtSignal(object). Frames: newest-frame slot per camera with at most one queued delivery (stale frames dropped, never unbounded); QImage built on the GUI thread with .copy().

stop_all waits for per-camera stop jobs with a 10 s total bound (STOP_ALL_TIMEOUT_S). Unknown camera ids in operational methods are logged and ignored; update_camera/remove_camera raise KeyError. update_camera restarts a running view after replacing the service. stop_view failures are only logged (no command_failed).

TapoCameraService PTZ: spec control.ptz.move says +x right, +y UP (y = (taps_up - taps_down)*step), so dy>0 maps to positive y_coord, no sign flip. Single-axis hold-to-move uses client.step(direction) (singalMove, the app's press-and-hold request [spec:control.ptz.move_step]: 0 right, 90 up, 180 left, 270 down); diagonals use client.move(dx*10, dy*10). Deviation from the orchestrator's 'use move(x,y)' suggestion: motorMove is a relative 10-unit nudge, not a continuous move.

TapoCameraService: get_status tolerates TapoDeviceError per getter (default value) so a model without e.g. an LED still syncs; alarm = last value set (no getter). recordings_for_day passes the local tz. start_stream reuses the supervisor via switch() unless FAILED/STOPPED; stale supervisor callbacks muted by a generation counter. close() cancels downloads (threading.Event), stops events/stream and closes the control client.

Smoke-tested TapoCameraService and MainWindow+AppController(default factory) against MockTapoCamera on a scratch copy merged with wave3/control and wave3/onvif: login, device info, status get/set, PTZ (singalMove/stopMove/motorMove), presets, days/clips search and an ONVIF motion event all worked. Live video and downloads not smoke-tested: media lane was not committed yet.
Default factory builds one shared StreamLimiter and PinStore(<data dir>/pins.json) lazily; if the media lane's StreamLimiter fails, every service creation fails (seen before merge).

Lane additions: AppController.camera(id); CameraGrid.tile(), toggle_fullscreen(), fullscreen_camera_id(); VideoTile.set_name/name/stream_state/set_selected/is_selected; MainWindow.selected_camera_id(), editCameraButton + list double-click edit; PlaybackPanel refreshRecordingsButton, downloadStatus label; TrayController.hide()/show_window()/is_available(); app.main accepts --debug and -h/--help (0). Closing to tray is skipped (quits instead) when a TrayController exists but the platform has no system tray.
Decode sizes are fixed per quality (HD/TELE_HD 1280x720, SD/TELE_SD 640x360), so resizing never restarts ffmpeg.
